title: Import Form Data from Tally
text: Tally uses personal API keys. Create one Tally Settings > API keys, store TALLY_API_KEY environment variable .Renviron (e.g. via usethis::edit_r_environ()): check setup, run: , quick check ’re authenticated:
code: TALLY_API_KEY=tly-xxxx library(tallyr) tally_sitrep() tally_whoami() #> ✔ Authenticated with Tally as Ella Kaye (hello@ellakaye.co.uk)

title: Import Form Data from Tally
text: work several Tally accounts, store account’s key TALLY_API_KEY_<NAME> environment variable: tally_accounts() lists accounts key available, tally_use_account() switches rest session: Every API function also takes account argument one-calls without switching:
code: TALLY_API_KEY=tly-xxxx TALLY_API_KEY_WORK=tly-yyyy TALLY_API_KEY_RLADIES=tly-zzzz tally_accounts() #> [1] "default" "rladies" "work"  tally_use_account("work") #> ✔ Using Tally account "work" tally_forms() # uses the "work" account tally_forms(account = "rladies")

title: Import Form Data from Tally
text: List forms find ID one want: import submissions wide tibble, one row per submission one column per question: Submissions can filtered completion status date: functions handle pagination automatically respect Tally’s rate limit 100 requests per minute.
code: tally_forms() #> # A tibble: 2 × 8 #>   id     name                status    number_of_submissions is_closed … #> 1 3xLJ5V Conference feedback PUBLISHED                    42 FALSE #> 2 7bQm2W Workshop signup     DRAFT                         0 FALSE tally_submissions("3xLJ5V") #> # A tibble: 42 × 5 #>   submission_id submitted_at        is_completed `What's your name?` … #> 1 nWxyzA        2026-06-01 10:00:00 TRUE         Ada #> 2 nWxyzB        2026-06-02 11:30:00 TRUE         Grace #> # … tally_submissions(   "3xLJ5V",   filter = "completed",   start_date = "2026-01-01" )

title: Work with multiple Tally accounts — tally_accounts
text: tally_accounts() lists accounts key available. tally_use_account() switches active account rest session; tallyr functions use account unless given explicit account argument.

title: Situation report for your Tally setup — tally_sitrep
text: Reports everything relevant tallyr working: accounts keys available active, whether active account's API key found (), whether looks like Tally key, whether online, whether key actually authenticates Tally API. Ends recommendations fixing anything wrong. Never errors, whatever state setup.
